integrity: Exact formulas and first-layer classifications have algebraic proofs. Finite computations are numerical checks, not proofs for all \(n\). A related original source published only to month precision in 1971 is acknowledged; the stated first-public-day is the verifiable arXiv submission of the earliest inspected precisely dated operator source.
scientific_limitations: The spectral data use a declared Hermitian basis normalization. They are not claimed to be gauge invariants, nor is a general simplified higher-layer zero-pattern classification supplied. The theorem concerns the second Sweedler power only.
scientific_scope: For every integer \(n\ge2\), the second Sweedler power on the complex Taft Hopf algebra with orthonormal PBW monomials admits an explicit Fourier–Hankel singular spectrum; its first nilpotent layer satisfies a sharp parity-dependent singular-value and condition-number law.
title: Exact Fourier–Hankel singular spectra for the Taft Hopf-square operator
